status: FROZEN -- confirmed correct by hand. Never change these pixel values or re-run detection over them. A future piece (e.g. armor) gets its own new entries; it never edits an existing one.
note: Pixel-space joint markers found in the mannequin body-part PNGs (assets/rigs/mannequin/). Each PNG has a small grey ring with a black outline drawn at each anatomical joint; two adjacent pieces that connect share the exact same joint pixel (e.g. rearUpperArm_elbow == rearForearm_elbow). Found by flood-filling the fully-transparent background of each PNG and isolating the small enclosed holes bounded by ink strokes -- see the detector script used to build this file, reproduced in dev/rig-preview.js history. canvasSize is [width, height] and is the same for every piece (1145x1374). Every bone's own anchor in data/rigs/humanoid-art-mannequin.json is anchor = proximalJointPx / canvasSize, so rotation happens purely around this pixel -- that anchor file is ALSO frozen, together with this one and the bind-pose bone positions in humanoid.json / humanoid-aqw-bind-preview.json. Together these three files ARE the mannequin skeleton. Do not move any of them.
jointNaming: Each key is <bodyPart>_<jointName>, proximal-to-distal per limb: shoulder (upper arm <-> torso) -> elbow (upper arm <-> forearm) -> wrist (forearm <-> hand). Legs: hip (thigh <-> hips) -> knee (thigh <-> shin) -> ankle (shin <-> foot). weaponMount and offhandMount are the item-holding points distal of each hand; they have no drawn ring of their own (no art), they're pure bone offsets (8 units straight out from the hand bone, see humanoid-aqw-bind-preview.json) and are listed here only for reference completeness.

rearHand.note: 8 units straight out from rearHand, no art of its own
